title: ActionIntent
description: Strict, parsed representation of a single staff request mapped onto exactly one Action-Registry action. Produced by the planning layer, reviewed by a human, and handed to the bridge. additionalProperties is false everywhere: an intent that does not fit this shape is rejected rather than guessed.

action_name.description: Must match an action_name in actions.json.

patient_identifiers.description: Identifiers the staff request supplied. Strong match requires emr_id, or dob + exact first_name + last_name, or dob + phone. Name/phone/email alone is a weak match and MUST halt for human review.

emr_id.description: Exact SIS patient_id or Svigg acct.

action_inputs.description: Action-specific inputs (date, time, provider, cpt00, demographics, note payload, ...). Validated per-action by the bridge Pydantic models, not by this schema.

missing_fields.description: Required inputs the request did NOT supply. Non-empty means the intent is incomplete and cannot execute.

reason.description: Short plain-language justification for this mapping (shown to the human approver).
